items.entry: jobs_controller renders notes and description, neither is a column
items.quote: jobs_controller.rb:17,19 render job.notes and job.description; the jobs table has neither. schedule.tsx:45,47 maps both into every ticket.

items.entry: No route creates or updates a job
items.quote: routes.rb:11-15 declares only POST /api/sessions, DELETE /api/session, GET /api/jobs. The new-ticket form and the move-ticket dialog have no endpoint to call. Blocks the two 'not persisted' entries below.

items.entry: Moving a ticket is not persisted
items.quote: schedule.tsx:167-180 updates local state only; a refresh reverts it. Different from the existing 'move dialog not styled' to-do, which is appearance.

items.entry: Sections are matched against area.name with nothing keeping them in sync
items.quote: schedule.tsx:150 filters ticket.location === section; location is area.name straight from the DB (jobs_controller.rb:16). Any area not named exactly one of the nine strings drops its tickets silently. Code vs database, where the two entries above are code vs code. Decides [[should-the-prep-job-section-be-split-into-prep-and-wash]].

items.entry: Subscription failures are invisible and the socket never reconnects
items.quote: schedule.tsx:71-83 handles only ping and job_updated, ignoring confirm_subscription and reject_subscription; onclose at :85 only logs. Given the nil-user rejection, a rejected subscription looks exactly like an idle connection.

items.entry: authFetch is rebuilt every render and sits in the effect deps
items.quote: auth.tsx:40 is not memoised and schedule.tsx:54 depends on it, so jobs refetch whenever AuthProvider re-renders rather than when the token changes.

items.entry: Section list is duplicated verbatim in two files
items.quote: schedule.tsx:13-23 and MoveTicketDialog.tsx:20-30 hold the same nine strings.

items.entry: Part ids collide because addPart uses prev.length + 1
items.quote: new-ticket.tsx:36. Remove part 2 of 3 then add one and two parts share id 3 -- which is the React key.

items.entry: Dead duplicate CORS config in initializers/cors.rb
items.quote: cors.rb is commented out end to end while the live rule sits in application.rb:33-38. Two places to look, one inert. The origins '*' value itself is gh#10; this is the duplication.
